projects.fullDescription:
### Overview
The **AI-Powered Customer Support Assistant** is a full-stack conversational platform engineered to automate enterprise customer service. Powered by **Google Gemini 2.0 Generative AI**, it eliminates rigid, hardcoded chatbots by dynamically synthesizing natural, human-like answers for account recovery, billing, order tracking, and technical support.

### Key Features
- **🤖 Generative AI Engine**: Powered by `@google/genai` (Gemini 2.0) with alternating multi-turn conversation memory.
- **🌐 11 Global Languages**: 1-click header language selector (English, Spanish, Hindi, French, German, Tamil, Telugu, etc.).
- **📊 Real-Time Admin Dashboard**: Live KPI metrics (Total Tickets, Resolved Count, Escalation Rates), sentiment pie charts, and security audit logs.
- **🔒 Secret `/admin` URL Route**: Dedicated route listener for secure administrative portal access.
- **⚡ Resilient Architecture**: Express MVC backend with zero-downtime offline datastore emulation.

### Tech Stack & Live Links
- **Tech Stack**: React 18, Node.js 20, Express MVC, Socket.IO, MongoDB Mongoose, Recharts, Render, Vercel.
- **Live Frontend**: https://ai-support-final-server-five.vercel.app
- **Live Admin Portal**: https://ai-support-final-server-five.vercel.app/admin
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/johnknox0118/ai-support-final-server

projects.title: Smart Campus Management & Security Telemetry Platform
projects.description: An enterprise-grade full-stack campus operating system featuring real-time GPS tracking, cybersecurity spoof detection, automated attendance marking, bus fleet telemetry, leave workflows, and emergency SOS alarms wrapped in a modern glassmorphism UI.
projects.event: Full-Stack Web SaaS / Enterprise Campus OS
projects.fullDescription:
# Smart Campus OS — Enterprise Telemetry & Security Platform

## 📌 Executive Overview
Smart Campus OS is a commercial-grade, full-stack campus telemetry and management platform built to handle real-time geospatial tracking, automated attendance, transit fleet operations, leave request approvals, and emergency distress alarms for Prathyusha Engineering College (PEC). 

Designed with a high-density, dark-mode Glassmorphism design system (inspired by Apple VisionOS, Linear, and Tesla Fleet Dashboards), the platform provides 6 distinct role-based views (Admin, Staff, Student, Driver, Security, Non-Teaching Staff).

---

## 🔑 Key Features & Subsystems

1. 🛡️ Cybersecurity & GPS Spoofing Detection Engine
   - Real-time telemetry processing with anti-spoofing heuristics.
   - Detects impossible movement speed (>15 km/h walking, >80 km/h vehicle), client-side mock GPS flags, and concurrent multi-device logins.
   - Triggers real-time security warnings and flags malicious telemetry logs.

2. 📍 Interactive Satellite Tracking & Geofencing
   - High-performance Leaflet.js interactive satellite maps powered by Google Maps Hybrid tiles.
   - Automatic 7-zone circular geofencing (Entire Campus, Academic Block, Library, Hostels, Parking, Sports Ground).
   - Live user location search bar with instant pin locator and camera focus.

3. 📋 Automated & Manual Attendance Management
   - Geofence-triggered automatic check-in/check-out calculation.
   - Manual marking roster with instant Present / Absent / On-Duty / On-Leave circular toggle controls.
   - Report download center generating instant Excel (.xlsx) and PDF (.pdf) summary reports.

4. 🚌 Transit Fleet Operations & Driver Telemetry
   - Real-time bus tracking with live speed, route stops, and dynamic ETA calculation to main campus.
   - Driver trip console with periodic automatic location broadcast.
   - Complete Admin CRUD interface for fleet configuration and driver assignment.

5. 🚨 Emergency SOS Distress System
   - One-click panic SOS trigger broadcasting exact GPS coordinates.
   - Instant critical alert dispatch to all active Admin and Security staff feeds.
   - Resolution workflow with audit logging.

6. 📝 Leave Approval Workflow
   - Student/Staff leave filing with automatic date range validation.
   - Department-filtered approval panel for staff/admin decisions.

---

## 🛠️ Technical Architecture & Stack

- Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript (SPA View Router), HTML5, Custom Glassmorphism CSS Design System, Bootstrap 5, FontAwesome 6
- Mapping & Charts: Leaflet.js (Google Hybrid Satellite Tiles), Chart.js
- Backend API: Python Flask (RESTful Blueprints API architecture)
- Database: SQLite & Flask-SQLAlchemy (11 normalized models)
- Authentication & Security: JWT (Flask-JWT-Extended), Bcrypt Password Hashing, Session Management, Account Lockout Security (5 failed attempts limit)
- Document Export: openpyxl (Excel), ReportLab (PDF)
- Deployment: Gunicorn on Render / Static Vercel

projects.title: AegisX – Enterprise AI-Powered Cyber Defense & SIEM Platform
projects.description: An enterprise-grade cybersecurity command center featuring real-time SIEM log correlation, automated SOAR active containment, CIS compliance auditing, AI malware sandboxing, and WebGL network visualizations.
projects.role: Lead Full-Stack Security Engineer & UI/UX Architect
projects.fullDescription:
AegisX is a next-generation Enterprise Cybersecurity Operations Command Platform designed for SOC analysts, threat hunters, and security engineers to monitor, analyze, and automatically mitigate cyber threats in real time.

KEY ARCHITECTURAL HIGHLIGHTS & CAPABILITIES:

• SOAR Active Containment Engine: 1-click active response routines supporting automated process termination (PID kill), firewall IP block rule creation (netsh / iptables), network isolation of compromised hosts, and user account lockouts.
• SIEM Log Correlation & WebSockets Push: Ingests real-time operating system logs (Windows Event Logs & Linux Syslog) with automated rule correlation pushing instant alert banners over WebSockets (ws://).
• CIS & Multi-Framework Compliance Engine: Conducts real-time host hardening audits against CIS Benchmarks, NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001:2022, and PCI-DSS 4.0 with 1-click CLI remediation scripts.
• AI Malware Sandbox & Vulnerability Scanner: Shannon entropy calculation, YARA-like binary pattern matching, and Nmap target network vulnerability scanning mapped against CISA KEV and MITRE ATT&CK libraries.
• Modern Futuristic Aesthetics: Built with high-contrast cybersecurity Dark Mode, custom WebGL Three.js ribbon background shaders, glassmorphism cards, dynamic Recharts data visualizations, and an ultra-responsive layout for Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop displays.

TECH STACK:
• Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Three.js (WebGL), Recharts, Lucide Icons, Axios, TanStack React Query.
• Backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Uvicorn, SQLAlchemy ORM, PyJWT, Psutil, Scapy, SQLite / PostgreSQL.
• Deployment & DevOps: Docker Compose, Nginx, Render Cloud PaaS, Vercel Serverless Edge CDN, GitHub Actions.

ctfQuestions.title: Patch Database Injection Query
ctfQuestions.description: Select the secure implementation to patch string concatenation vulnerability:
ctfQuestions.clue: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '" + userInput + "';

options.text: A) Strip quote characters using regex replace.
B) SECURE: Use Parametrized Prepared Statements (e.g. Prisma ORM / $1 parameters).
C) Wrap query string inside eval().

ctfQuestions.hint: Parametrized prepared statements ($1) isolate query logic from data inputs.
